Mayawati Appoints Nephew Ishan Anand as National Coordinator

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) supremo Mayawati has appointed her younger nephew, Ishan Anand, as the National Coordinator of the party. This move comes ahead of upcoming elections, with Anand replacing Akash in the role. The appointment was made during a BSP National Meeting.
